summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with unit conversion but introduces a non-invertible matrix error handling mechanism that may not be comprehensive enough.

issues.description: The PR does not fully resolve the issue of orthogonal unit combinations. It only handles the case where the matrix is non-invertible, but other edge cases or invalid conversions might still occur.
There are no additional tests provided to ensure that the change correctly handles the intended use cases and does not introduce new regressions.
